sections.title: No Dilution, No Waiting
sections.description: Manual dilution costs time and introduces a real source of error before a sample even reaches the instrument. NanoPhotometer N120 reads sub-microlitre volumes directly, so that step disappears entirely. A broad detection range, dsDNA from 2 to 8,000 ng/µl and BSA from 0.06 to 230 mg/ml, means most samples fall within a single measurable window without needing a dilution series to bring them into range. Twelve channels finish a full run in 20 seconds, turning what would be a sequential, one-sample-at-a-time process into a genuinely parallel one.

Regulated environments get built-in support too: GMP, GLP, and GxP readiness, 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and an available IQOQ option mean documentation and audit needs are addressed from day one, not bolted on afterward. sections.title: One Instrument, Two Measurement Modes
sections.description: Nucleic acid quantification and cuvette-based assays like OD600 usually sit on separate instruments in separate parts of the lab. NP80 puts both modes on the same device. Microvolume mode starts at 0.3 µl, covering dsDNA up to 16,500 ng/µl and BSA up to 478 mg/ml, well suited to fast, dilution-free quantification of precious extracted samples. Cuvette mode extends sensitivity to the other end of the range, dsDNA down to 0.1 ng/µl and BSA down to 0.003 mg/ml, opening up full dynamic range work like OD600 monitoring and reaction kinetics. Switching between the two doesn't mean switching instruments, benches, or software, just changing the measurement mode on the same device.

body: N30-Touch measures from just 0.3 µl, using Sample Compression Technology to form a capillary film between two scratch-resistant, metal-free quartz surfaces, eliminating surface tension issues and evaporation risk during measurement.
True Path Technology holds two fixed anchor points for exact path length, giving recalibration-free accuracy for the lifetime of the instrument.

Standard detection covers dsDNA from 5 to 1,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 44 mg/ml, across a 200 to 650 nm scan range, expandable to 1 to 16,500 ng/µl, 0.03 to 478 mg/ml, and 200 to 900 nm with the Performance Package.
A full scan completes in 2.5 to 4 seconds, with no lamp warm-up time needed thanks to the xenon flash lamp, rated for 10⁹ flashes and up to 10 years of service life.
A 7" color touchscreen with adjustable angle runs the onboard NPOS operating system, with an illuminated sample window and easy-to-clean surfaces, including compatibility with alcohol-based solvents.
Three upgrade packages, Performance, Applications, and Connectivity, let the instrument's capabilities expand later without replacing the hardware.
Over 10,000 units are installed globally, and the NanoPhotometer platform is referenced in more than 15,000 scientific publications worldwide.
The instrument carries CE, IEC 61010-1:2012, and EN 61326-1:2013 certification, with a 12-month warranty as standard.

sections.title: Recalibration-Free by Design
sections.description: Recalibration cycles cost time and, over the life of an instrument, money. N30-Touch's sealed optics remove that recurring task entirely, guaranteeing lifetime accuracy without it. Sample Compression Technology forms a contained capillary film between two fixed quartz surfaces, removing dependence on surface tension and preventing evaporation throughout the entire measurement. True Path Technology locks path length in place using two fixed anchor points, so there's no drift to correct for over time, and no costly recalibration visit required. Durable, inert, scratch-resistant surfaces also mean no reconditioning is needed to keep those surfaces performing accurately.

sections.eyebrow: Growing the Instrument on Your Terms
sections.title: Growing the Instrument on Your Terms
sections.description: Buying capability the lab doesn't need yet, or being stuck without capability it grows into needing, are both real costs. N30-Touch's three upgrade packages let capability expand exactly when it's needed, not before.
body: The Performance Package extends detection range for both DNA and protein measurement, from 5-1,500 ng/µl to 1-16,500 ng/µl dsDNA, and expands the full spectrum scan mode from 200-650 nm to 200-900 nm.

The Applications Package unlocks the full range of intuitive applications: protein assays (BCA, Bradford, Lowry), kinetics, OD600 cell density, wavescan, standard curve generation, and additional features like Sample Control™ Technology and dye label measurement.

The Connectivity Package adds Wi-Fi, USB A/B, HDMI, and LAN connections, remote control via PC, tablet, or smartphone, LIMS integration through REST API and Push Service, and 64 GB of onboard data storage.
